home_sub: Your crypto safety companion for the Lightchain AI (LCAI) community. Before you buy a token, connect to a site, or send funds anywhere — run it through here first. It takes seconds and could save you everything.
home_intro: OrcaGuard puts eight safety tools in one place. From checking unknown contracts and phishing URLs, to auditing your own wallet and learning how scams work — everything is explained in plain English, no technical background needed.
home_card_contract_desc: Paste any token address to instantly see if it's safe, suspicious, or a known scam.
home_card_url_desc: Verify a URL before connecting your wallet — one wrong site can drain it in seconds.
home_card_wallet_desc: Confirm a destination address is valid before sending crypto you can never get back.
home_card_audit_desc: Connect your wallet for an instant health check — balances, network, and scam token scan.
home_card_breach_desc: Find out if your email has appeared in a known data breach using Have I Been Pwned.
home_card_buylcai_desc: Native DEX, ERC-20 Uniswap, official bridge ERC-20→native, and fakes to avoid.
home_card_scams_desc: Know the most common tactics scammers use to steal from crypto holders.
home_card_tips_desc: Gas fees, slippage, wallet connections, and transaction signing — explained simply.
home_card_ask_desc: Describe any situation and get a plain-English safety verdict powered by Lightchain AIVM.
contract_sub: Paste any token contract address before you buy, approve, or interact with it. OrcaGuard will tell you if it's safe, suspicious, or a known scam — in plain English.
contract_hint: Paste the full contract address starting with 0x
contract_info_native_title: 💡 Native LCAI on Lightchain Mainnet has no contract address — and that's normal
url_sub: Before connecting your wallet to any website, paste the URL here first. One wrong click on a phishing site can drain your entire wallet in seconds.
url_hint: Paste the full URL from your browser's address bar
url_warning_title: ⚠️ Never connect your wallet to a site you're not sure about
url_warning_p: Scammers buy Google and social media ads for fake versions of Uniswap, MetaMask, and other tools. The fake site looks identical. Once you connect and approve a transaction, your wallet is drained instantly and can't be recovered.
wallet_sub: Before sending crypto anywhere, verify the destination address. One wrong character and your funds are gone forever — there's no bank to call, no reversal.
wallet_hint: Paste the address you're about to send crypto to
wallet_bot_desc: Paste any wallet address to check if it looks like a trading bot. OrcaGuard will check on-chain activity on both Ethereum and Lightchain, then give you a plain-English verdict.
wallet_warning_title: 🚨 Never send to an address from a DM
wallet_warning_p: If anyone sends you a wallet address in Discord, Telegram, or Twitter DMs and asks you to send them crypto — it's a scam. Legitimate projects never ask you to send funds to verify a transaction, claim a reward, or unlock your account.
audit_sub: Connect your wallet for an instant health check — network, balances, and a hygiene report. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere. All checks run directly from your browser.
audit_connect_sub: Works with MetaMask and Trust Wallet browser. We only read your public address and balances — we never request transaction approval.
audit_airdrop_desc: Scammers airdrop fake tokens into wallets to trick you into visiting phishing sites or approving malicious contracts. This scanner checks all ERC-20 tokens your wallet ever received on Ethereum and flags anything suspicious.
audit_what_p: When you connect, OrcaGuard automatically checks: which network you're on, your ETH balance (needed for gas), your LCAI balance, and flags any immediate concerns. For a full approval audit, we link you to Revoke.cash — the gold standard for approval management.
audit_trust_title: 📱 Trust Wallet tip — portfolio view vs. DApp browser
buylcai_sub: Lightchain AI (LCAI) is not listed on every exchange. Scammers create fake tokens with the same name. Here's where to buy real LCAI, how to bridge ERC-20 to native, and where not to.
buylcai_bridge_title: 🌉 How to bridge ERC-20 LCAI → native LCAI
buylcai_coinbase_p: Lightchain AI (LCAI) is not listed on Coinbase. If you search "LCAI" on Coinbase and find a result, it is a scam token with the same name. Do not buy it. Always verify the contract address.
buylcai_uniswap_p: Scammers run ads for fake versions of Uniswap. The only real Uniswap is app.uniswap.org. Bookmark it. Never click a Uniswap link from a search engine result or social media post.
buylcai_verify_title: 💡 How to verify any token before buying
scams_sub: These are the most common ways crypto holders lose money. Knowing these patterns is your best protection.
tips_sub: Stuck connecting your wallet? Confused by gas fees? These are the most common problems crypto holders run into — and how to fix them.
tips_wallet_title: 🔌 Can't Connect Your Wallet to a Lightchain Site?
tips_wallet_intro: This is one of the most common issues, especially on mobile. Desktop browsers handle wallet connections differently than phones, and some sites don't support all methods equally.
tips_gas_intro: Gas is the fee you pay to the network to process your transaction. Think of it like a tip to the validators who keep the network running. On Ethereum, gas is paid in ETH — and it can get expensive.
tips_slippage_title: 📊 What Is Slippage — and How to Set It
tips_slippage_intro: Slippage is the difference between the price you expect to pay and the price you actually pay when your transaction goes through. Crypto prices move constantly, so by the time your transaction is confirmed, the price may have shifted slightly.
tips_sign_title: 📋 Before You Sign Any Transaction — Read This
tips_sign_intro: Every transaction your wallet asks you to sign is a request to do something with your money or permissions. Most wallet drains happen because someone signed something without understanding what it was.
breach_sub: Find out if your email address has appeared in a known data breach — password leaks, hacked databases, and more. Powered by Have I Been Pwned, the most trusted breach database in the world.

ask_welcome:

I'll give you a straight answer in plain English. 🛡️
